---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Meredith Fraser"
date: 2026-09-10
---

![First couple of weeks on campus.](/images/first_weeks_banner.jpeg)

The MDS program kicked off in the last week of August, 2026 with a whirlwind three days of orientation 
events. During orientation, I had the chance to meet my fellow classmates, professors, and all the 
folks who help keep the program running, as well as get acquainted with the program structure and the UBC 
West Point Grey campus. 

Having spent very little time on the UBC campus prior to starting the program, I was surprised by 
just how big campus is (read: accepting any and all insight on shortcuts for commuting between classes 
in the 10 min breaks) and also by how much green space there is on campus. Having access to the Pacific 
Spirit Regional Park has been a gift and I anticipate going on many trail runs in the park over the next 
10 months while I complete the MDS program.

While I did manage to get lost on several occasions on campus in these first few weeks and I suspect 
it may be a few more weeks before git add/commit/push become as second nature to me as breathing is, 
I would like to think I am otherwise finding my feet in the MDS program and my new home in Vancouver. 
The courses are engaging, the materials interesting, our professors and TAs are helpful and supportive, 
and I am looking forward to what comes next.
